* 310, Garfield County. One mile east of Battlement Mesa, CO. Grass. Extreme fire behavior with running, 
torching and spotting. Residences and energy infrastructure threatened. Evacuations and road closures in 
effect. 
 
Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. CIMT (RM Team 1). CIMT (RM Team 2) mobilizing. 
CIMT is also managing the Gold Mountain incident. Seven miles northwest of Lake City, CO. Timber, brush 
and grass. Active fire behavior with uphill runs, backing and torching. Numerous structures threatened. Area, 
road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Gold Mountain, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Two miles north of Ouray, CO. Grass, 
brush and timber. Moderate fire behavior with backing, uphill runs and torching. Energy infrastructure 
threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Rio Blanco, San Juan NF, USFS. Ten miles south of Pagosa Springs, CO. Timber, brush and grass. 
Moderate fire behavior with flanking and smoldering. Numerous structures threatened. 
 
Aspen Acres, Custer County. Twenty miles southwest of Pueblo, CO. Timber. Minimal fire behavior with 
backing and creeping. Numerous residences and communication infrastructure threatened. Area and road 
closures in effect. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. 
Minimal fire behavior. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
* Montgomery Draw, Campbell County. Fifteen miles northwest of Gillette, WY. Grass and brush. Moderate 
fire behavior with wind-driven runs.
